qt: to the Commission Helmut Scholz (The Left) Subject:

at: (English version) to the Commission Helmut Scholz (The Left) (22 March 2024) Subject: Examination of a German federal grant to PCK GmbH In July 2023, an application for a federal grant of some EUR 400 million was received by the Commission for the reinforcement of the pipeline between Rostock and the PCK refinery in Schwedt. 1.
What is the current status of the grant application?

2. Russian company Rosneft, which is subject to fiduciary administration by the German Federal Network Agency, has a stake in PCK GmbH. What effect could this have on the grant application process? 3.
When does the Commission expect the grant application process to be finalised?

(15 May 2024) As regards public support for the upgrading of the oil pipeline between Rostock and the refinery in Schwedt, the Commission is in contact with the German authorities. The Commission is neither in a position to comment further on the content of such discussion, nor can it predict the timing or outcome.
